text: たんパン　うごき　やすくって　いいぜ！

structure.jp: うごき　やすくって
structure.en: are easy to move in, and so

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.span: うごき　やすくって
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb stem says the action is easy to do. うごき やすい = 'easy to move in'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: やすくって　いいぜ
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this to what follows, here giving the reason; くって is a casual, punchy way of saying くて. うごき やすくって いい = 'they're easy to move in, so they're great'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, boyish way to sound confident. いいぜ = 'they're great, man!'
